 Published  November 3, 2026 6:40 PM EST The Brief
 The Florida midterm election is today, Tuesday, November 3, 2026. 
 Polls are open from 7 a.m. - 7 p.m. local time. Shortly after polls close, initial election results will be released. 
 Voters will decide the race for St. Pete Mayor between Ken Welch and former Gov. Charlie Crist. 
 St. Petersburg voters are deciding who will lead the city for the next four years, with incumbent Mayor Ken Welch facing former Florida Gov. Charlie Crist in a closely watched mayoral race.
 The election is nonpartisan, and both candidates are registered Democrats. Crist, however, previously held several elected positions as a Republican, including serving as Florida governor, before switching parties in the mid-2000s.
 When are election results released? 
 Polls in Florida are open from 7 a.m. - 7 p.m. local time. Shortly after polls close, initial election results will be released.
